name: Toggle / Toggle Group
summary: Named exclusive mode-selection group whose target-owned native buttons expose synchronized boolean pressed state with normal tab order.

behavior.name: pressedState
behavior.description: Each slotted native button exposes a boolean aria-pressed value. Neutral web progressively synchronizes exactly one pressed item after pointer or keyboard activation and preserves the native bubbling click.

behavior.name: stateOwnership
behavior.description: Targets own option labels, values, initial selection, selection effects, and persistence. Neutral web is uncontrolled after reading authored initial state; framework targets may control the value while updating every item atomically.

behavior.name: keyboardModel
behavior.description: Every item remains a normal Tab stop; arrow keys and roving focus are not captured by this pressed-button pattern.

behavior.name: motionPreference
behavior.description: Decorative surface, text, and border transitions are removed when reduced motion is requested without changing selection.

behavior.name: contentResilience
behavior.description: The group can shrink to its container and localized or indivisible item labels wrap rather than forcing page-level horizontal overflow.

properties.name: groupLabel
properties.description: Accessible name for the related toggle-button set.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Disables every native toggle button when the entire choice is unavailable.

accessibility: Expose pressed state with aria-pressed or native radio semantics depending on the target pattern.
Provide a group label when multiple toggles represent one setting.
Keep exactly one item aria-pressed=true for the accepted exclusive pattern.
Preserve normal Tab order and do not add Toolbar arrow-key behavior.
Honor reduced-motion preferences for decorative transitions.
Allow localized or unbroken labels to wrap without page overflow.

web.notes: CSS owns resilient presentation and reduced motion; shared progressive enhancement normalizes and synchronizes one exclusive aria-pressed state while preserving native activation.
